subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should the remaining local-avatar work be limited to clearer UI/API diagnostics while preserving the current 2 MB workspace-contained file-serving boundary, or should the open fork PR's parser/path changes be adopted after review?
rationale: The current implementation already serves valid local workspace avatars, while the remaining behavior affects local file-serving safety, user-facing error disclosure, and an open contributor PR that claims to close this issue.

options.title: Keep boundary, add diagnostics
options.body: Preserve the current shared avatar policy and add clear UI/API feedback for too-large, missing, unsupported, or outside-workspace avatars.

options.title: Refresh the fork PR narrowly
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebuild only the parser/path fix on current main while retaining size-limit and containment tests.

options.title: Close as current behavior
options.body: Treat the 2 MB limit and metadata reason as sufficient, then close the issue and the linked fork PR with that rationale.

recommendation.title: Keep boundary, add diagnostics
recommendation.body: Preserve the current shared avatar policy and add clear UI/API feedback for too-large, missing, unsupported, or outside-workspace avatars.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across avatar support, avatar file-serving hardening, and the Control UI route security boundary.
